summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests sotorasib in people with brain tumors that have a KRAS G12C change. Participants receive sotorasib at the FDA-recommended dose or continue their previous dose as their doctor directs, and the route, duration and frequency are not stated. The record does not name a main outcome measure; it says the study will look at how well sotorasib gets into the tumor and whether it is safe in people having surgery.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba sotorasib en personas con tumores cerebrales que tienen un cambio KRAS G12C. Los participantes reciben sotorasib a la dosis recomendada por la FDA o continúan con la dosis que recibían, según indique su médico; la vía, la duración y la frecuencia no se indican. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio busca saber qué tan bien sotorasib llega al tumor cerebral y si es seguro en personas que se someten a cirugía.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with one or more brain tumors planned for surgical removal or biopsy.
People with leptomeningeal spread are eligible if they also have brain tumor needing removal or biopsy.
Karnofsky performance status of at least 60.
Adequate blood counts, kidney, liver and clotting values within 7 days before treatment.
not_for: Known allergy or hypersensitivity to the study treatment or its excipients.
Multiple primary cancers within 3 years, with listed exceptions such as curatively treated in-situ disease.
Need for ongoing transfusions or growth factor support to keep platelets or hemoglobin at required levels.
Liver enzyme or bilirubin levels above the stated limits.
